name: Greenville County, SC
findings: Greenville County has 1,505 nonprofit organizations. 657 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 508 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Greenville County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few union organizations list membership
observations.text: 4 union organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 21 would.

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through union groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Greenville County list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 51% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 33 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Few professional organizations list public events
observations.text: 12 professional organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 30 would.

confidence.text: Based on 30 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through professional groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 108 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 108 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.
